title: REQ · History loading, empty, error and list states are identifiable and asserted
summary: History states each have a test id and a test
description: Context: loading, empty and error messages have test ids; the list does not. Desired behavior: the history list carries a test id. Expected result: tests assert loading, empty, error with Retry and populated list. Why: SG-8.5 history coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending history request, when the sheet opens, then contribution-history-loading is shown
Given an empty history, when it loads, then contribution-history-empty is shown
Given a failing history request, when it settles, then contribution-history-error and a Retry button are shown
Given two past suggestions, when history loads, then contribution-history-list contains both prompts marked Sent

in_scope: Test id on the suggestions list
